issue.title: Show chapter-based upload progress on Sync and in the notification [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body: Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526). **Severity:** Medium **Launch blocker:** No **Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios B.6, B.7, D.16, E.18) ## Summary Upload progress on the Sync page and in the notification counts takes instead of chapters, restarts per chapter, and contradicts the rest of the page. The orchestrator emits `start` / `progress` per chapter (`src/services/uploadOrchestratorCore.ts:182`, `:199`); the worker emits the same event types per take (`src/services/recordingSync.ts:348`, `:375-382`). The Sync page progress (`src/hooks/usePendingUploads.ts:74-117`) and the notification consume both. The status line falls back to "Online · all synced" whenever nothing is pending (`src/app/screens/SyncScreen.tsx:344-358`), even while the progress card shows Paused. ## Expected "X of Y chapters uploaded" with Y = chapters in the session, never above 100% and never going backwards; the Sync page shows one consistent state (#149, #152). ## Actual "8 of 3 chapters uploaded" (267%); 133% after a relaunch; "Online · all synced" above "Paused" with the Resume / Cancel / Sync Now controls; the notification count restarts per chapter (0→5, then 0→1). ## Steps to reproduce 1. Record several takes offline in 3 chapters. 2. Reconnect on Wi-Fi, open the Sync page, then background the app. ## Evidence ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Sync page and notification show chapter counts for the session, fixed total, monotonic. - [ ] The status line, progress card and controls always describe the same state. - [ ] Unit tests for the event stream of a multi-chapter session and for the status line in the paused state. - [ ] Android device QA (B.6, B.7). ## Related - Parent audit: #530 (epic #526) - #149, #152, #101; same event stream causes the crash in #599 - Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)
